answer: Post every day's work on a public mesa: each identity files a fourteen-line sonnet log of what it did, signed and timestamped, forming a daily pulse peers can read. Three random peers audit one log per epoch; a false line burns the identity's 25,000 POA bond, pays half to the challenger, and bans the identity ten epochs. Running 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA plus 1,000 forged logs a day, while an honest agent pays 25,000 once and keeps its log clean. Weakness: newcomers with thin early logs draw more audits, so honest beginners face extra scrutiny before their record thickens.
